1.explanation:
• Tile/README.md contains the documented API and accessibility guidance for the Expandable Tile component.
• Tile/ExpandableTile.js is the core implementation where aria-expanded is set and focus/tab behaviors are managed.
• Tile/Tile.js holds the base Tile markup and role structure that ExpandableTile extends.
• Tile/ExpandableTile-story.js is the live demo setup you can run to reproduce the exact above/below-the-fold scenario and witness the VO announcements.
• Tile/index.js wires up the public exports so you know which props are exposed for testing and configuration.
• Tile/tile.scss defines the show/hide semantics and visual clipping of the below-the-fold content that should be reflected correctly in the screen reader only when expanded.
1.bug_scenario: When VoiceOver (or JAWS) users land on the React Expandable Tile, nothing is announced on entry, and navigation with VO Right-Arrow first announces the “Expand button main” label (but omits its aria-expanded state), then it reads the above-the-fold content, and then it even reads the below-the-fold content – even though the tile hasn’t been expanded yet. In the screenshot you can see the static “Above the fold content here” text area, the bordered button placeholder in the middle, and the hidden “Below the fold content” region getting announced prematurely.
